# m.partners.benzinga.analyst_insights

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Benzinga analyst insights on US stocks: a rating, a price target, and the reason.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.partners.benzinga.analyst_insights(symbols=None, *, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `BenzingaId`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | US stock tickers. Leave it out for every ticker; `dm.ALL` is refused. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any field of the rows, such as `"date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. A watchlist's `fetch()` caps every request instead. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"date_gte": "2026-01-01"}`. Keys: `benzinga_firm_id`, `benzinga_firm_id_any_of`, `benzinga_firm_id_gt`, `benzinga_firm_id_gte`, `benzinga_firm_id_lt`, `benzinga_firm_id_lte`, `benzinga_rating_id`, `benzinga_rating_id_any_of`, `benzinga_rating_id_gt`, `benzinga_rating_id_gte`, `benzinga_rating_id_lt`, `benzinga_rating_id_lte`, `date`, `date_any_of`, `date_gt`, `date_gte`, `date_lt`, `date_lte`, `firm`, `firm_any_of`, `firm_gt`, `firm_gte`, `firm_lt`, `firm_lte`, `last_updated`, `last_updated_gt`, `last_updated_gte`, `last_updated_lt`, `last_updated_lte`, `rating_action`, `rating_action_any_of`, `rating_action_gt`, `rating_action_gte`, `rating_action_lt`, `rating_action_lte`, `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Analyst Insights (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Benzinga Analyst Insights | Updated in real time, All history |
| Benzinga Analyst Insights Business | Updated in real time, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `ticker`: "The stock symbol of the company being rated." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose symbol the library can't read. That row's `Symbol` is null. Null on every other row. When `MassiveConfig.unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, such a row fails the table instead, and the column is absent. |
| `BenzingaFirmId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for the firm record. |
| `BenzingaId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for this record. |
| `BenzingaRatingId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for the rating record. |
| `CompanyName` | String | The name of the company being rated. |
| `Date` | String | The calendar date (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD) when the rating was issued. |
| `Firm` | String | The name of the research firm or investment bank issuing the rating. |
| `Insight` | String | Narrative commentary or reasoning provided by the analyst or firm to explain the rating or price target. |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The timestamp (formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp) when the rating was last updated in the system. |
| `PriceTarget` | double | The current price target set by the analyst. |
| `Rating` | String | The current rating set by the analyst. |
| `RatingAction` | String | The description of the change in rating from the firm's last rating. Possible values include: downgrades, maintains, reinstates, reiterates, upgrades, assumes, initiates_coverage_on, terminates_coverage_on, removes, suspends, firm_dissolved. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
